function.name: fetch_observatory_data
function.description: Download one day of minute data for one INTERMAGNET observatory (three-letter IAGA code). Call this first, before any analysis. Returns df_descriptor 'raw:<STATION>:<date>'; reuse it verbatim.

station_code.description: Three-letter IAGA station code, e.g. IRT. Known: IRT=Иркутск, MOS=Москва, NVS=Новосибирск, SPG=Санкт-Петербург, YAK=Якутск, KHB=Хабаровск, MGD=Магадан, VLA=Владивосток, PET=Паратунка (Камчатка), ARS=Арти, BOX=Борок, TIK=Тикси

data_type.description: Publication state. 'auto' walks a fallback chain. Default 'definitive'.

function.name: create_project
function.description: Start a named project. Every later artifact is filed under it as <station>/<date>/ with a manifest recording the observatory, the data version, the download time and the agent commit. Call this before fetch_many or export_project. Calling it again with the same name reuses the existing project rather than failing.

name.description: Short human-readable project name, e.g. 'Boreal storm 2024'. Letters, digits, spaces, '-' and '_' only; the name is normalised into a folder name.

function.name: fetch_many
function.description: Download one date range for SEVERAL observatories in one call. Use instead of repeating fetch_observatory_data. Stations share one download budget; each returns its own df_descriptor. A station that fails is listed under 'failed' while the rest still succeed.

data_type.description: Publication state. 'auto' walks a fallback chain. Default 'definitive'.

max_downloads.description: Ceiling on downloads for this call, shared by all stations. Defaults to 8. Windows beyond the ceiling are refused and listed under 'refused' rather than fetched.

project.description: Project to file the data under. Defaults to the open project.

function.name: list_projects
function.description: List the projects currently on disk.

function.name: export_project
function.description: Zip a project: canonical tree, charts, manifests and a metadata index. Returns the archive path.

name.description: Project to export. Defaults to the open project.

archive_name.description: Optional ZIP name, only when the user explicitly asks; '.zip' is added if absent.

folders.description: Folders (A/B, '.'=root) to project_chart_paths, dirs or globs.

folder_layout.description: auto(default): files directly, dirs/globs as tree; direct: all directly; tree: source paths.

sort_by.description: Index order, e.g. ['source','station','date'] or ['date','source']. Default station,date,components,source,file.

source_order.description: Custom source order for the index, e.g. ['OMNI','INTERMAGNET','KYOTO','SUPERMAG'].

include_index.description: Write index.csv and index.html. Default true.

function.name: create_task_matrix
function.description: Plan a large batch job as ONE matrix grouped BY STATION: one task per station carrying all its event dates. Use INSTEAD of a long list of tool calls when the job spans many stations/dates (>~15 units). Then call process_matrix_batch once with run_until_complete=True.

actions.description: What to do for each (event, station) cell, in order. Words 'fetch', 'calc_HDI', 'plot' map to the handlers; full handler names also work. Default: fetch, calc_HDI, plot.

project_name.description: Project that stores the results and the matrix.

shared_args.description: Arguments shared by every cell. For plot_space_weather_comparison supply solar_wind_df_descriptor (required), ground_component (default H) and solar_wind_components (default Bz,V). The matrix supplies ground_df_descriptor and a unique filename per cell.

export_args.description: Optional export_project arguments used by the automatic batch export: archive_name, folders, sort_by, source_order, include_index. Only set when the user explicitly asks for a custom archive/folder view.

function.name: process_matrix_batch
function.description: Execute the pending STATION tasks of a task matrix (read from the matrix_path create_task_matrix returned). run_until_complete=True finishes ALL pending stations in this one call, builds the project archive automatically, and returns a summary starting 'МАССОВАЯ ОБРАБОТКА ЗАВЕРШЕНА'; no separate export_project call is needed. False processes only batch_size stations (debugging).

run_until_complete.description: True = process every pending station to completion inside this one call (recommended). False = process only batch_size stations (debugging).

batch_size.description: Stations per call when run_until_complete=False. Default 5. Ignored when run_until_complete=True.

export_args.description: Optional export_project arguments for the automatic archive. Overrides export_args stored in the matrix.

function.name: calculate_derived_components
function.description: Compute the horizontal field H, declination D and inclination I from the Cartesian components X/Y/Z. Use this whenever H is needed.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

components.description: Subset to compute. Default all three.

function.name: get_statistics
function.description: Statistics (min/max/mean/median/std/count) for numeric frame columns, including Dst/Kp. Returns measured numbers.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

components.description: Numeric columns, case-insensitive. H/D/I can be derived.

function.name: detect_anomalies
function.description: Flag samples that deviate from the series mean by more than N standard deviations. Use for outlier and disturbance screening.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

function.name: calculate_derived_math
function.description: Measure a component over time as a scalar you may quote: 'delta' (max-min variation), 'dH_dt' (rate of change in nT/min), or 'anomaly' (value minus baseline_value from calculate_baseline). Returns a new derived df_descriptor holding the series, plus the scalar.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

metric.description: 'delta' = max - min over the window; 'dH_dt' = rate of change in nT/min; 'anomaly' = value minus baseline_value.

component.description: Component to measure. H is the usual choice.

window.description: Optional block size in samples for metric='delta'. Omit it to get one variation for the whole day; set it to get the largest excursion within any block.

baseline_value.description: Required for metric='anomaly'. The quiet reference to subtract, e.g. the 'baseline' from calculate_baseline.

function.name: calculate_baseline
function.description: Establish a reference level for a component. mode='night' takes the mean over the specified UTC window (00:00-04:00 by default). The window is not automatically selected for quietness and is not necessarily local night. Returns the baseline value; pass it to calculate_derived_math with metric='anomaly'.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

mode.description: 'night' = mean over the quiet night window (default). 'full' = mean over every sample, which includes the storm and so is a poor quiet reference.

night_hours.description: Night window as [start_hour, end_hour] UTC, default [0, 4].

function.name: evaluate_custom_formula
function.description: Compute a custom arithmetic expression over a frame's columns; returns a new plottable series. Use for a quantity the built-in tools do not cover, e.g. 'sqrt(X**2 + Y**2) + Z/10'. Columns: D, F, H, I, X, Y, Z plus the frame's own numeric columns. Operators: + - * / % **. Functions: abs, acos, asin, atan, atan2, cos, degrees, exp, hypot, log, log10, maximum, minimum, power, radians, sign, sin, sqrt, tan, plus pi and e. The formula is parsed, never executed.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

formula.description: The expression, e.g. 'sqrt(X**2 + Y**2) + Z/10'. Column names must be upper case.

function.name: plot_components
function.description: Plot components of ONE table to HTML. Accepts real columns case-insensitively, including X/Y/Z/F/H/D/I, dst_proxy and Kyoto Dst/Kp. Returns the file path.

df_descriptor.description: A descriptor from a previous tool, copied EXACTLY from its 'frame_handle': a slot like 'raw:irt:2024-09-10' or a family name 'raw' / 'derived' / 'anomalies'. Never invent one; see 'available_handles' in the last result.

components.description: Components/columns to plot, e.g. ['Dst','Kp'] for the Kyoto indices frame or ['H','dst_proxy'] for a derived observatory frame.

layout.description: auto by units; stacked separate panels in one HTML; overlay shared axis.

function.name: plot_comparison
function.description: Overlay two different days of one component on a shared time-of-day axis. Use it to compare, for example, a storm day against a quiet day. ЗАПРЕЩЕНО использовать для сравнения данных солнечного ветра и магнитного поля Земли: инструмент умеет только две даты одной компоненты одного типа данных. Для Земли vs космоса используй ТОЛЬКО plot_space_weather_comparison.

df1.description: First day: a frame_handle copied from a previous tool result, e.g. 'raw:irt:2024-09-10'.

df2.description: Second day: a frame_handle from a *different* slot than df1, e.g. 'raw:irt:2024-09-11'.

component.description: Component to compare across the two frames; any real column, including the Kyoto indices 'Dst'/'Kp'.

function.name: get_station_geomagnetic_coords
function.description: Tilted-dipole geomagnetic coordinates (geomag_lat, geomag_lon) of one station. USE when the user asks how far north a station is in geomagnetic terms, or before comparing storm amplitudes across stations. DO NOT USE to get the station's geographic latitude/longitude, and do not call it for data download.

function.name: calculate_mlt
function.description: Magnetic Local Time (MLT) of one station at a UTC instant; mlt_hours in [0,24), MLT=12 means magnetic noon. USE for 'what magnetic time is it at X'. DO NOT USE when the user wants longitude-based mean solar local time -- that is calculate_local_time; MLT and LT differ by the magnetic-vs-geographic longitude.

function.name: group_stations_by_mlt
function.description: Group several stations into MLT bins at one UTC instant. USE to see which stations sit in the same magnetic-time sector. DO NOT USE for local/civil time, and do not call it once per station -- it takes the whole list.

function.name: calculate_local_time
function.description: Local mean solar time (LT): UTC + geographic longitude/15, wrapped to [0,24). Returns lt_hours, lt_hm and local_mean_solar_datetime. Not civil timezone time, not apparent solar time (no equation-of-time correction), not magnetic local time. USE for longitude-based local/solar time; magnetic local time uses calculate_mlt.

function.name: apply_physics_formula
function.description: Apply a physics formula to a stored frame and return a derived frame with the new column. For solar-wind metrics, pass 'solar_wind_handle': the system aligns solar wind data with the ground station frame automatically.

df_descriptor.description: Handle of the ground station or indices frame, from 'frame_handle'.

metric.description: Name of the metric to calculate. Available: ey_coupling, burton_coupling, akasofu_epsilon, peak_dhdt, substorm_onset, eej_index, dst_proxy, ssc_flag, sq_baseline, deltas, gic.

solar_wind_handle.description: Handle of solar wind frame. Required for: ey_coupling, burton_coupling, akasofu_epsilon.

reference_handle.description: Handle of reference station frame. Required for: eej_index.

window_seconds.description: Window size in samples for 'peak_dhdt' (default 10 = 10 minutes on a 1-minute grid).

function.name: calculate_eej_index
function.description: Use for the equatorial electrojet, EEJ, or the H-difference between an equatorial and an off-equatorial station. Downloads BOTH stations for the date range, aligns them and returns H_equatorial - H_reference as a derived frame. Do NOT use apply_physics_formula for EEJ (one frame only). REQUIRED: 'equatorial_station', 'reference_station' (IAGA codes) and 'start_date'. Require an explicit justified pair; never call IRT equatorial. Raw H-difference is a proxy, not validated EEJ. Report missing data; never substitute another date/station.

equatorial_station.description: Three-letter IAGA code on the dip equator, e.g. IRT.

reference_station.description: Three-letter IAGA code 6-8 degrees away in latitude, e.g. ABG.

end_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Defaults to start_date.

function.name: plot_overlay
function.description: Draw ONE component from SEVERAL stations on ONE chart (per-station nT offset; x axis UT/LT/MLT; north-first; auto-fetches missing days). REQUIRED: 'stations' = LIST of IAGA codes, e.g. ['IRT'] (NOT a frame handle); 'dates' = list of YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. ['2024-09-12']; 'component' = one string, e.g. 'H'. 'df1'/'df2' DO NOT EXIST here. Correct call: {"stations": ["IRT"], "dates": ["2024-09-12"], "component": "H"}. Two days of one station → plot_comparison. Earth-vs-solar-wind → ONLY plot_space_weather_comparison.

stations.description: REQUIRED. List of IAGA station codes to overlay, e.g. ['IRT'] or ['IRT','API','BSL']. A list of codes, never a df1/df2 frame handle.

dates.description: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD; one date shared by all stations, e.g. ['2024-09-12'].

component.description: Single component to overlay, e.g. 'H'. Default 'H'.

components.description: Alias for 'component': a list, e.g. ['H']. First entry is drawn; must be a frame column (X/Y/Z/F/H/D/I).

function.name: plot_space_weather_comparison

ground_df_descriptor.description: Ground handle, e.g. 'raw:irt:2024-09-12' or a 'derived:...' frame with 'dst_proxy'.

solar_wind_components.description: RIGHT axis, e.g. ['Bz','V'] (also Bx, By, Np).

function.name: fetch_solar_wind
function.description: Download L1 solar-wind data (NASA/OMNI, 1-minute: speed V, density Np, temperature T, IMF Bx/By/Bz in GSM) for a date range. USE this to find the CAUSE of a geomagnetic storm (southward Bz + fast V). Returns frame_handle 'sw:omni:<START_DATE>' to pass to apply_physics_formula (metric='ey_coupling'). DO NOT USE for observatory data.

end_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive. Defaults to start_date.

function.name: fetch_geomagnetic_indices
function.description: Download geomagnetic activity indices (Kyoto WDC: hourly Dst, 3-hourly Kp) for a date range -- the storm SEVERITY record. USE this to VALIDATE a local proxy: compare the station's 'dst_proxy'/'dH_dt' against the official Dst and Kp. USE alongside fetch_solar_wind to describe a storm. Returns frame_handle 'idx:kyoto:<START_DATE>' whose plottable columns are 'Dst' (nT) and 'Kp' (0-9); draw them with plot_components. DO NOT USE for observatory magnetograms.

end_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive. Defaults to start_date.

function.name: get_noaa_space_weather_context
function.description: Official NOAA SWPC layer: current geomagnetic alerts (G1-G5), the 3-day planetary Kp outlook, the GOES X-ray flare catalogue. Correlate these official figures with local observatory data and Kyoto indices. NOT for raw solar-wind measurements (V, Bz, ...): that is fetch_solar_wind. query_type picks one of 'alerts' | 'forecast' | 'solar_events'.

query_type.description: 'alerts' = active geomagnetic alerts/warnings (G1-G5); 'forecast' = 3-day Kp/G-scale forecast; 'solar_events' = X-ray flare catalogue for a date range.

end_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive. Defaults to start_date.

function.name: fetch_supermag_data
function.description: Скачивает данные с базы SuperMAG. Используйте это для получения возмущенных компонент (dX, dY, dZ) с уже удаленной базовой линией, или для получения глобальных индексов суббурь (SME, SML, SMU), указав data_type='indices'. station_code НЕОБЯЗАТЕЛЕН: при data_type='indices' его передавать не нужно.

station_code.description: НЕОБЯЗАТЕЛЕН. Нужен только при data_type='sites' (напр. 'IRT'); при 'indices' игнорируется.

end_date.description: Конечная дата, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), включительно. Максимум 32 дня.

data_type.description: 'sites' = минутные данные станции dX/dY/dZ (базовая линия уже удалена); 'indices' = глобальные SME/SML/SMU, станция не нужна.

function.name: get_iswa_perturbation_map
function.description: Карта наземных возмущений ISWA (WMS ground_mag_perturbation) — ДЕКОМИССИРОВАНА: NASA CCMC удалила публичный WMS-слой при миграции, инструмент вернёт service_decommissioned. SuperMAG SME/SML/SMU — временные ряды индексов, не замена пространственной карте.

bbox.description: [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]; по умолчанию весь мир.

function.name: get_iswa_forecast
function.description: Прогноз Dst/Kp из ISWA (HAPI): Kp на 3-часовой сетке — наблюдённый/оценённый/предсказанный (поле kp_kind); Dst — nowcast Kyoto, вперёд не прогнозируется. Аргументов не требует.
